items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Hoyford Smith was a saxophone player, an alto saxophone, and Thomas Parker was playing the tenor saxophone.

ctx.x: You were going into missions and taking a nap.

Yeah, yeah. See everybody at night. We were taking a nap. Well, they had a couple of entertainers around there, singers, dancers, and had a piano player. He was a man of piano. Yeah, I'll tell you. Hoyford Smith was a saxophone player, an alto saxophone, and Thomas Parker was playing the tenor saxophone.
